C006.name: Dodoma City Council
C006.documented: drought and failed rains on the semi-arid plateau (under 800 mm a year), strong winds, wildfire, flash floods in the short wet season, and water shortage

area.en: Dodoma City: seasonal streams and fast-growing suburbs
area.sw: Jiji la Dodoma: vijito vya msimu na mitaa mipya inayokua

risk.en: This area is semi-arid ground on the central plateau: seasonal streams through the city are dry for months but flash-flood within an hour of a storm, while long dry seasons strain water supply; the area also lies near active Rift faults.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni ardhi kame ya uwanda wa kati: vijito vya msimu jijini huwa vikavu kwa miezi kadhaa lakini hufurika ghafla ndani ya saa moja baada ya dhoruba, huku kiangazi kirefu kikiathiri upatikanaji wa maji; eneo pia liko karibu na mipasuko hai ya Bonde la Ufa.

advice.en: For those living and building here, it helps to keep stream channels and setbacks clear, build to approved standards on firm ground and store water safely for the dry months. What raises the risk: building inside dry stream beds because they look safe, blocking channels with plots or waste, and putting up unreinforced walls near the fault lines. Know the higher ground away from the stream that you will move to, and cross or leave the valley before the storm water arrives, not when the stream is already running. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kujenga hapa, ni vyema kuweka mikondo ya vijito na umbali wa ujenzi wazi, kujenga kwa viwango vilivyoidhinishwa kwenye ardhi imara na kuhifadhi maji salama kwa miezi ya kiangazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga ndani ya mikondo mikavu ya vijito kwa sababu inaonekana salama, kuziba mikondo kwa viwanja au taka, na kujenga kuta zisizoimarishwa karibu na mipasuko. Fahamu sehemu ya juu mbali na kijito utakayohamia, na vuka au ondoka bondeni kabla maji ya dhoruba hayajafika, si wakati kijito tayari kinatiririka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C002.name: Kondoa Town Council
C002.documented: drought, strong winds, flash floods on the Bubu, gully erosion, and water shortage

area.en: Kondoa Town: eroded gullies and river crossings
area.sw: Mji wa Kondoa: makorongo yaliyomomonyoka na vivuko vya mito

risk.en: This area has some of Tanzania's most eroded land: bare slopes shed run-off into deep gullies that flash-flood through town, undercut roads and bury fields in sand.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina ardhi iliyomomonyoka zaidi nchini: miteremko mitupu hupeleka maji kwenye makorongo marefu yanayofurika ghafla mjini, yakimomonyoa barabara na kufunika mashamba kwa mchanga.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep vegetation and terraces on slopes, check-dam gullies and build away from gully edges and sandy river beds. What raises the risk: clearing the last trees on bare slopes, grazing gully heads and building or farming in the sandy river beds. Know the firm high ground you will move to, and leave the gully edges and river crossings as soon as rain starts upstream; a dry gully can fill within minutes. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea na matuta kwenye miteremko, kujenga vizuizi vya makorongo na kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo na mito ya mchanga. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukata miti ya mwisho kwenye miteremko mitupu, kulisha mifugo kwenye vichwa vya makorongo na kujenga au kulima kwenye mito ya mchanga. Fahamu sehemu ya juu imara utakayohamia, na ondoka kwenye kingo za makorongo na vivuko mara mvua inapoanza juu ya mto; korongo kavu linaweza kujaa ndani ya dakika chache. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C007.name: Bahi District Council
C007.documented: drought, the Bahi wetland drying in poor years, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods when the Bubu rises

area.en: Bahi: Bahi swamp and rice plains
area.sw: Bahi: bwawa la Bahi na tambarare za mpunga

risk.en: This area surrounds the Bahi swamp: in wet years the swamp spreads over rice fields and villages, while in dry years the same plains face crop failure and water shortage.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linazunguka bwawa la Bahi: katika miaka ya mvua nyingi bwawa hupanuka na kufunika mashamba ya mpunga na vijiji, huku katika miaka ya ukame tambarare hizo hukumbwa na mazao kukauka na uhaba wa maji.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep homes and stores on higher ground, use the swamp edge seasonally for rice and keep a food and seed reserve for dry years. What raises the risk in wet years: building permanent houses and stores on the swamp edge, and blocking the natural outflow with bunds and roads. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use, and move people, stores and animals there when the swamp begins to spread, before the plains are cut off. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga makazi na maghala sehemu za miinuko, kutumia kingo za bwawa kwa msimu kwa mpunga na kuweka akiba ya chakula na mbegu kwa miaka ya ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari katika miaka ya mvua nyingi: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye kingo za bwawa, na kuziba njia ya asili ya maji kwa matuta na barabara. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia, na hamisha watu, akiba na mifugo huko bwawa linapoanza kupanuka, kabla tambarare hazijafungwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C005.name: Chamwino District Council
C005.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and water shortage for livestock and crops

risk.en: This area receives low, erratic rainfall in a single season; dry spells and early cessation of rain often cause crop failure and food shortage.
risk.sw: Eneo hili hupata mvua kidogo zisizo za uhakika katika msimu mmoja; vipindi vya ukavu na mvua kukatika mapema mara nyingi husababisha mazao kukauka na upungufu wa chakula.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant drought-tolerant crops such as sorghum, millet and sunflower, harvest rainwater and keep household food reserves. What raises the loss when the rains fail: relying on maize alone, selling the whole harvest at once and cutting trees for charcoal when money is short. Agree early, as a household and a village, where people and animals will go for water and food in a failed season, and move stock or seek support before the reserves run out, not after. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame kama mtama, uwele na alizeti, kuvuna maji ya mvua na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hasara mvua zikikosekana: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja na kukata miti kwa mkaa pesa zinapopungua. Kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, watu na mifugo wataenda wapi kupata maji na chakula msimu ukikosekana, na hamisheni mifugo au ombeni msaada kabla akiba haijaisha, si baadaye. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C008.name: Chemba District Council
C008.documented: drought on the northern Dodoma plain, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods in gullies

area.en: Chemba: dry plains and seasonal rivers
area.sw: Chemba: tambarare kame na mito ya msimu

risk.en: This area is dry pastoral and farming land where drought reduces pasture and water, and sudden storms send flash floods along seasonal rivers that cut roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni ardhi kame ya ufugaji na kilimo ambako ukame hupunguza malisho na maji, na dhoruba za ghafla hupeleka mafuriko kwenye mito ya msimu yanayokata barabara.

advice.en: For those living and herding here, it helps to protect dry-season grazing and water points, keep homes off seasonal river beds and plan journeys around storm periods. What raises the risk: camping or building in the dry river beds, and keeping more animals than the dry-season water points can serve. Know the high ground away from the rivers and the dry-season grazing you will move to, and move the herd and the family early, before the river rises or the animals weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuchunga hapa, ni vyema kulinda malisho na vyanzo vya maji vya kiangazi, kujenga mbali na mito ya msimu na kupanga safari kuzingatia vipindi vya dhoruba. Kinachoongeza hatari: kupiga kambi au kujenga kwenye mito mikavu, na kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko vyanzo vya maji vya kiangazi vinavyoweza kuhudumia. Fahamu sehemu ya juu mbali na mito na malisho ya kiangazi utakayohamia, na hamisha mifugo na familia mapema, kabla mto haujajaa au mifugo haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C001.name: Kondoa District Council
C001.documented: drought, severe gully erosion on the Kondoa highlands, flash floods on the Bubu, strong winds, and wildfire

risk.en: This area lies in the Irangi hills, where steep, over-grazed slopes erode quickly; heavy storms trigger gully growth, soil loss and occasional slope failures.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko kwenye milima ya Irangi, ambako miteremko mikali iliyolishwa kupita kiasi humomonyoka haraka; dhoruba kubwa husababisha makorongo kupanuka, upotevu wa udongo na mara chache kuporomoka kwa miteremko.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep grass cover and terraces on slopes, control grazing on steep land and plant trees along gullies. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, grazing them bare and building below gully mouths. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and away from the gullies, and move there when cracks open above the houses or the run-off turns heavy and brown during a storm. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha nyasi na matuta kwenye miteremko, kudhibiti malisho kwenye ardhi yenye mteremko mkali na kupanda miti kando ya makorongo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuilisha hadi kuwa tupu na kujenga chini ya midomo ya makorongo. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na mbali na makorongo, na hamieni huko nyufa zikianza kufunguka juu ya nyumba au maji ya mvua yakiwa mengi na ya kahawia wakati wa dhoruba. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C004.name: Kongwa District Council
C004.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, and flash floods on the Mkondoa headwaters toward Kilosa

area.en: Kongwa: dry plains and grazing land
area.sw: Kongwa: tambarare kame na maeneo ya malisho

risk.en: This area is dry plain with sandy soils where failed or late rains quickly reduce harvests, pasture and water for people and livestock.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni tambarare kame yenye udongo wa mchanga ambako mvua zikikosekana au kuchelewa mavuno, malisho na maji kwa watu na mifugo hupungua haraka.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to grow drought-tolerant crops, protect water points and plan livestock numbers to match available pasture. What raises the loss when the rains fail: ploughing sandy soils bare, letting herds crowd the few water points and clearing woodland for charcoal. Agree early where the herds and the families will go for water and pasture in a dry year, and move before the animals weaken; sell some stock while they are still in good condition. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame, kulinda vyanzo vya maji na kupanga idadi ya mifugo kulingana na malisho yaliyopo. Kinachoongeza hasara mvua zikikosekana: kulima udongo wa mchanga hadi kuwa tupu, kuacha mifugo isongamane kwenye vyanzo vichache vya maji na kukata misitu kwa mkaa. Kubalianeni mapema mifugo na familia zitaenda wapi kupata maji na malisho mwaka wa ukame, na hamieni kabla mifugo haijadhoofika; uzeni baadhi ya mifugo ikiwa bado na afya nzuri. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C003.name: Mpwapwa District Council
C003.documented: drought, strong winds, wildfire, flash floods, and landslides on the Rubeho escarpment

area.en: Mpwapwa: hill slopes and the Mpwapwa river
area.sw: Mpwapwa: miteremko ya milima na mto Mpwapwa

risk.en: This area lies below steep hills where heavy rain sends flash floods down the Mpwapwa river and its gullies through town and farmland, with erosion and occasional landslides on slopes.
risk.sw: Eneo hili liko chini ya milima mikali ambako mvua kubwa hupeleka mafuriko ya ghafla kwenye mto Mpwapwa na makorongo yake mjini na mashambani, pamoja na mmomonyoko na mara chache maporomoko kwenye miteremko.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to build back from river banks and gullies, keep trees and terraces on slopes and keep drainage channels open. What raises the risk: building on the river bank or at gully mouths, cutting into the hill slopes behind houses and dumping waste in the channels. Know the high ground away from the river that you will move to, and go when heavy rain is reported on the hills above town, before the Mpwapwa river rises through the streets. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujenga mbali na kingo za mto na makorongo, kuacha miti na matuta kwenye miteremko na kuweka mifereji wazi. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye ukingo wa mto au midomo ya makorongo, kuchimba miteremko ya milima nyuma ya nyumba na kutupa taka kwenye mifereji. Fahamu sehemu ya juu mbali na mto utakayohamia, na ondoka mvua kubwa inaporipotiwa milimani juu ya mji, kabla mto Mpwapwa haujajaa na kupita mitaani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
